label: early copy steps (recall 1-3) in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original or delimiter steps. It is concentrated at the 2nd-4th outputs (recall_idx 1-3; recall_idx 2, i.e. two steps after <DEL>, carries 54% of mass and the top activations peak there), and in long sequences (L=9 holds 67% of mass, L=8 26%, almost nothing for L<=5). Activation rises and falls across a short run of 2-3 consecutive steps just after <DEL>. A weak secondary bump appears at the last copy steps of L=9 sequences. Even under these conditions it fires on only about half of the steps, and which sequences fire depends on token content in a way no simple token variable captured: out_tok i/x/m and digit-heavy sequences give modest lift. It does not fire during the original phase, at the delimiter step, at recall_idx 0, or late in the copy of short sequences. The predicate gets dev F1 0.61 with mass recall 0.87.
